about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. Jobber's 2026 Home Service Trends Report re-read on Oct 29, 2026 (26% of cleaning businesses reply within an hour, the fastest responders; 1,050 owners; Conjointly, December 2025; plus or minus 3 points at 90% confidence). The story numbers (11 pm, 7 am, two bed, one bath) and the prompt are examples, not data.

jobber.title: Blue Collar Strong: The 2026 Home Service Trends Report
jobber.quote: Cleaning businesses are the fastest responders (26% reply within an hour), while HVAC pros are the slowest.
jobber.method: a survey of 1,050 home service business owners across the United States, conducted through Conjointly in December 2025, with a margin of error of plus or minus 3 percentage points at the 90% confidence level
jobber.scope: Self-reported by owners. The page does not give the cleaning subsample size. Descriptive survey data, not a correlation.
jobber.context: The same page: 20% of all pros respond within the hour (not used in the video).

story.source: OURS: an example story, not data (shown with EXAMPLE on screen)
story.message: Hi! Need a move-out clean before Friday. 2 bed, 1 bath. How much?
story.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out! A move-out clean for a 2 bed, 1 bath is [your rate]. Want the inside of the fridge and oven done too? Friday works.

prompt.source: OURS: advice, an example prompt (no AI product named)
prompt.line1: Write a short, friendly reply to this cleaning quote request.
prompt.line3: Ask one question if anything's missing.
prompt.note: lines is the count of sentences in the prompt itself, not a finding
